# Go module path prefixes of telemetry, analytics, crash-report and
# self-update libraries. Meru sends nothing off the machine and never checks
# for updates (AGENTS.md, non-negotiable 2). OpenTelemetry is absent from this
# list on purpose: Meru uses it, and internal/obs refuses a non-loopback
# endpoint.
#
# Same format as model_provider_modules.txt.

github.com/getsentry                   # Sentry crash reports
github.com/bugsnag                     # Bugsnag crash reports
github.com/rollbar                     # Rollbar crash reports
github.com/honeybadger-io              # Honeybadger crash reports
github.com/segmentio/analytics-go      # Segment analytics
github.com/posthog                     # PostHog analytics
github.com/mixpanel                    # Mixpanel analytics
github.com/amplitude                   # Amplitude analytics
github.com/DataDog                     # Datadog agents and tracers
gopkg.in/DataDog                       # Datadog tracer, old path
github.com/newrelic                    # New Relic agent
github.com/honeycombio                 # Honeycomb exporters
github.com/rhysd/go-github-selfupdate  # self-update from GitHub releases
github.com/creativeprojects/go-selfupdate  # self-update
github.com/minio/selfupdate            # self-update
github.com/inconshreveable/go-update   # self-update
github.com/sanbornm/go-selfupdate      # self-update
